subject: Candidate scoring discrepancy — Jordan Park / request to confirm offer timing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate scoring discrepancy: Jordan Park (Frontend Staff)

Soojin,

Quick heads up — loop finished this morning for Jordan Park (referred via Claire at Recruitly). Overall strong fit for Staff Frontend, but the panel scores diverge a lot: four interviewers 8/9 and one interviewer gave a 3 with very terse notes.

I'm inclined to move to offer (we need to fill the Q3 hire), but exec wants a short audit on the low score before we extend anything. I attached the raw score export (interview-scores-20260714.pdf).

Can you coordinate a quick consolidation of notes and (if possible) a redacted copy we can present to comp committee? Also want to confirm timing — Jordan's other process at NimbleApps looks like it's moving fast; Claire says they want an answer within a week.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Staff Engineering Manager, Product Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate scoring discrepancy: Jordan Park (Frontend Staff)

On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 10:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Soojin,
>
> Quick heads up — loop finished this morning for Jordan Park...

Thanks Vivek — I pulled the score export and flagged the outlier. Monica, can you pull the debrief notes (redact any personal/irrelevant items) and summarize the single low-scoreer's comments? If it's a judgment call (e.g., culture fit language) we should surface it to Neha/comp quickly.

Vivek — timeline-wise, if the candidate needs an answer within 7 days we should prioritize a comp pre-read. I'm ok to propose a band and a base offer (plus typical stock range) pending Neha's sign-off. Attaching candidate-qual-notes-redacted.pdf with current redactions.

Next steps I propose:
- Monica: 24h consolidation of interviewer notes (redacted)
- Neha: quick comp band recommendation + any compliance flags
- Vivek: confirm final role level you want to propose to comp

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate scoring discrepancy: Jordan Park (Frontend Staff)

Soojin / Vivek — attached are the consolidated (redacted) notes. Summary below:

- Interviewers A/B/C/D: consistent positive signals (strong system design, product sense, ownership examples). Scores 8/9.
- Interviewer E (low score): flagged concerns around lack of recent leadership examples and "concise communication in async threads". Score 3.
- E's written notes are brief and reference a specific past project outcome; they did not hold a calibration call with other interviewers before submitting.

My read: the low score is specific to one interviewer's rubric focus (leadership examples) rather than a broad technical failing. Candidate is senior IC with strong product alignment.

Attachments: candidate-qual-notes-redacted.pdf

If Neha wants a verbatim excerpt from E for comp, I can pull it but I recommend redaction for the verbatim comment.

-Monica

--
Monica Patel
Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate scoring discrepancy: Jordan Park (Frontend Staff)

Team — thanks for the quick consolidation. A few notes from People/Comp perspective:

1) We will schedule a 30-minute comp pre-read today with the comp committee (15:30 PT). Please be prepared to present: proposed level (Staff IC), proposed salary band, target equity, and any performance caveats.
2) On the low score: if it's a rubric mismatch, that is not automatically disqualifying. We need a brief note (1 paragraph) that explains why the majority signal outweighs the outlier. Monica, please prepare that paragraph for the packet.
3) Compliance check: Claire (recruiter) confirmed candidate is open to verbal offer prior to formal paperwork. Do not share salary history or anything protected.
4) If comp approves, we'll send a verbal offer + start date window. We can draft the offer-terms-draft.docx after the call and iterate.

One ask: Soojin, please include a bullet about proposed start date and any counter-offer risk. Vivek, confirm you are fine with Staff IC band and the usual leveled title.

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Fox <claire@recruitly.io>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate scoring discrepancy: Jordan Park (Frontend Staff)

Thanks all — I joined the comp pre-read and we approved proceeding with a verbal offer for Staff IC. Details agreed: base midpoint for the Staff band, target equity of 0.4% with standard cliffs, and start date window of Sep 7–21. Monica will send the one-paragraph rationale for the low score for the comp packet.

Claire — please let Jordan know we are moving forward and expect to follow with terms (verbal) today; formal doc to follow early next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please loop me if Jordan pushes for a faster start or a competing offer.

-Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Staff Engineering Manager, Product Infra
Redwood Inference
